note: Backtests use today’s large-cap list (survivorship bias), daily closes and a 0.05% cost on each trade. Past results do not guarantee future results.

portfolios.name: Momentum Leaders
portfolios.tagline: The strongest large US stocks of the past year, refreshed monthly
method: Universe: about 100 of the largest US companies.
Rank by 12-month return, skipping the latest month (the classic 12-1 momentum measure).
Keep the top 10 that also trade above their 200-day average.
Equal weight, rebalanced on the first trading day of each month.
If fewer than 5 qualify, the empty slots sit in cash.

portfolios.name: Defensive Steady
portfolios.tagline: Calm, lower-volatility large caps that are still trending up
method: Universe: about 100 of the largest US companies.
Keep stocks with a positive 12-month return.
Pick the 10 with the lowest daily price swings (volatility) over the past year.
Equal weight, rebalanced monthly.

portfolios.name: Trend Guard
portfolios.tagline: The S&P 500 when it is above its 200-day average, cash-like Treasuries when it is not
method: Holds SPY (S&P 500 ETF) while SPY closed the month above its 200-day average.
Moves to BIL (1–3 month Treasury bills) when it closed below.
Checked on the first trading day of each month.
Aims to sit out long bear markets; it can lag in sharp V-shaped recoveries.

portfolios.name: All-Weather Mix
portfolios.tagline: Stocks, long and medium bonds, gold and commodities for every season
method: 30% VTI (US stocks), 40% TLT (long Treasuries), 15% IEF (medium Treasuries), 7.5% GLD (gold), 7.5% DBC (commodities).
A widely published "all-weather" style mix: some part of it tends to hold up in growth, recession, inflation and deflation.
Rebalanced back to target weights monthly.

portfolios.name: Tide Tilt
portfolios.tagline: More stocks when the money tide is rising, more bonds when it ebbs
method: 80% SPY / 20% IEF when the SPY 200-day trend is up and 6-month momentum is positive.
50% / 50% when only one of those is true.
20% / 80% when both are negative.
Live version adds the Tide liquidity score from M2 and Fed net liquidity (money.sixxab.com/liquidity) as a tiebreaker.
Rebalanced monthly.

portfolios.name: Quality Moats
portfolios.tagline: Growing revenue, solid margins, cash coming in, little debt
method: Universe: the SIXXAB US screener list.
Reads the latest SEC filings: revenue growth, net margin, operating cash flow and debt to equity.
Keeps the 8 strongest business scores that are not in a weekly downtrend.
Equal weight, rebalanced monthly.
Tracked live from launch: past company results as they were known at the time are not stored, so there is no honest backtest.
